description: This file defines the Security class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, handling document security features such as locking revisions, structure, windows, and managing passwords for revisions and workbook access.

classes.name: Security
classes.description: A class managing restriction locks and password protection for spreadsheet documents.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a new Document Security instance.

methods.name: isSecurityEnabled
methods.description: Checks if any security feature (revision, structure, window locks) is enabled.

methods.name: getLockRevision
methods.description: Returns whether revision locking is enabled.

methods.name: getLockStructure
methods.description: Returns whether structure locking is enabled.

methods.name: getLockWindows
methods.description: Returns whether window locking is enabled.

methods.name: setRevisionsPassword
methods.description: Sets the revisions password, optionally hashing it.

methods.name: setWorkbookPassword
methods.description: Sets the workbook password, optionally hashing it.
